title: Far Niente
meta_description: WaterColor Lake Views & Resort Amenities- Far Niente by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Far Niente by Royal Destinations Location: WaterColor Address: 385 Western Lake Drive Details: Far Niente is a luxurious WaterColor retreat located in the sought-after Park District and surrounded by the natural beauty of Western Lake. Offering approximately 3,242 square feet of interior living space, this spacious home comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with five bedrooms and 5.5 baths. Two separate living areas, a vaulted entry, and expansive porches provide plenty of room for families and groups to gather while still enjoying their own space. Bordering the nature preserve along Western Lake, Far Niente offers a peaceful setting with beautiful lake and preserve views from its porches and outdoor living spaces. Guests also enjoy access to WaterColor resort amenities, including the Beach Club, community pools, and tennis facilities. The WaterColor Beach Club is approximately a seven-minute walk from the home, while neighboring Seaside is just a short walk or bike ride away. With its exceptional location, generous layout, and access to WaterColor amenities, Far Niente provides an ideal setting for experiencing the best of 30A. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to WaterColor Beach Club: Approximately 7-Minute Walk -Distance to Seaside: Approximately 0.4 Mile / 10-Minute Walk -Parking Spaces: (3) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8-10 -Coffee Maker Available -WaterColor Beach Club Access* -Access to WaterColor Community Pools and Tennis Facilities* -Western Lake and Nature Preserve Views -(2) Living Areas -Screened Porch -Expansive Outdoor Porches -Outdoor Shower -Built-In Desk -Outdoor Gas Grill *WaterColor amenity wristbands are required for all guests ages 5 and older. An exact guest count must be provided prior to arrival, as WaterColor will only issue wristbands for the number of registered guests. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 5 Bedrooms / 5.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 3 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Bunks with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Secondary Living Room -Laundry Room -Half Bath -Covered Porch Second Floor: -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Detached Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 5 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Separate Tub, Walk-In Shower) -Kitchen / Main Living Room / Dining Area -Screened Porch -Balcony Please Note: *The second-floor living room fireplace is decorative only and is not available for guest use. *WaterColor amenity access and policies are subject to change. Please contact our office prior to arrival for the most up-to-date information regarding wristbands and community amenities. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
